title: Bottom "now playing " bar doesnt update frequiently enough tasks will often switch stages visually on theorchestrator but the bottom bar needs a full page refresh to work. same goes for queue number.  Obviously with performance as a limiting factor, can we try and keep queue number and active tasks for runners up to date as possible so users can use it to live monitor
goal:
# Bottom "now playing " bar doesnt update frequiently enough

tasks will often switch stages visually on theorchestrator but the bottom bar needs a full page refresh to work. same goes for queue number. 

Obviously with performance as a limiting factor, can we try and keep queue number and active tasks for runners up to date as possible so users can use it to live monitor
body:
# Bottom "now playing " bar doesnt update frequiently enough

tasks will often switch stages visually on theorchestrator but the bottom bar needs a full page refresh to work. same goes for queue number. 

Obviously with performance as a limiting factor, can we try and keep queue number and active tasks for runners up to date as possible so users can use it to live monitor
